No share sheet here

This browser will not open the Apple share sheet, so the PDF cannot be handed straight to Mail. That is the browser, not the form — everything you typed is safe.

Two things fix it:

  1. Open this page in Safari itself. Tapping a file inside another app — GitHub, Slack, Teams — runs it in that app's own browser, which has no share sheet.
  2. Check the address starts with https://. iOS blocks the share sheet on an insecure page.

Almost done — attach and send

  1. The completed PDF was saved to your Downloads folder:
  1. An email draft to should have opened.
  2. Drag that PDF into the draft and hit Send.
